answer: An agent economy can require each account to lock a scarce token in a vault before it may submit jobs or claim rewards. The protocol caps influence by stake, then slashes the bond when independent audits show fabricated work, so creating thousands of names does not create free voting power. A violet signal can flag suspicious clusters for review, but does not itself prove fraud. The attacker must acquire and immobilize real capital for every identity, and risks losing it if the Sybils are caught.
